html:
by Amy Hoglund

Memorial Day is right around the corner! It’s time to take a step back, honor our veterans, BBQ our way into summer with friends and family, and take advantage of the enormous shopping weekend! Stumped on what to do? Here are a few easy quick ideas that won’t break the bank.

Honor A Veteran

After all, this holiday is about supporting our troops and recognizing what many veterans have sacrificed for us to live in our beautiful country. Show your appreciation! You can create a social post saying thank you and offer an exclusive special for active service members and their family. Feature a brave veteran story on your social media channels- the ideas are endless!

Social Media Give-A-Way

Everyone loves free stuff! Give away a product or service to your social media followers to help build brand supporters and grow your business’s social reach, making sure they use a specific hashtag. You can use Facebook’s contest tool to set it up and target your audience accordingly as well.

Create A Mobile Coupon

Mobile is huge and people love to save a few bucks. Creating an online coupon also has other benefits- it’s extremely easy for your clients to receive, has little to no print costs, and you can even add an opt-in option for people to sign up to receive emails!

Enjoy your Memorial Day weekend with your family and friends. Stay tuned for more marketing tips and industry news!
